impact: The rule file is embedded in setup.ts at build time. After npm install -g zug-mcp@latest, the rule on disk is stale. Users must manually re-run zug setup to get the updated rule, but nothing tells them to.
resolution: cmdUpdate() now calls runSetup({ claude: true, quiet: true }) after npm install completes. This re-writes ~/.claude/rules/zug.md and re-registers hooks automatically on every update.
title: zug update does not refresh ~/.claude/rules/zug.md after upgrade
